## Introduction

This module is a SATA Register Module of Application Layer Unit and occupies two 256 bytes register spaces.

Note:

1\. SATA design share the same us/ms timer pulse, so all timer with N us/ms unit may have 1 us/ms inaccuracy.

## 2. Register Type

  ------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Attribute    Description

  **HwInit**   **Read-only register: Register bits are read-only and cannot be altered by software. Register bits may be initialized by hardware mechanisms such as pin strapping or serial EEPROM.**

  **RO**       **Read-only register: Register bits are read-only and cannot be altered by software. Register bits may be initialized by hardware mechanisms such as pin strapping or serial EEPROM.**

  **RW**       **Read-Write register: Register bits are read-write and may be either set or cleared by software to the desired state.**

  **RW1C**     **Read-only status, Write-1-to-clear status register: Register bits indicate status when read, a set bit indicating a status event may be cleared by writing a 1. Writing a 0 to RW1C bits has no effect.**

  **RWL**      **Read-Write or Locked register: Register bits are read-write and may be either set or cleared by software to the desired state when its Lock bit is cleared. A register bit becomes read only after its Lock bit is set.**

  **RW1CL**    **Write-1-to-clear status register or Locked register: Register bits are read-write and may be either set or cleared by software to the desired state when its Lock bit is cleared. While Lock bit is set, register bits indicate status when read, a set bit indicating a status event may be cleared by writing a 1. Writing a 0 to RW1CL bits has no effect.**

  **RsvdP**    **Reserved and Preserved: Reserved for future RW implementations; software must preserve value read for writes to bits.**

  **RsvdZ**    **Reserved and Zero: Reserved for future RW1C implementations; software must use 0 for writes to bits.**
  ------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

|     | Note: HW uses **H_SECTOR_CNT** and **H_SECTOR_CNT_EXP** to check when command completes. So when device receives some ATA non-NCQ command that its "Sector Count" and "Sector Count(exp)" doesn't means command requires transfer sector size, FW needs to update **H_SECTOR_CNT** and **H_SECTOR_CNT_EXP** manually before executing this command. | 1     | **SATA Application Layer Unit Reset**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | 0b      | WO         |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       | **(H_APU_RST):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       | This field is used to control the state machine reset of SATA application layer unit. Firmware writes one to this field then Hardware will generate 1T pulse to reset application layer. This field always returns zero when read.\                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|       | Reset area:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       | DMA engine, Manual FIS Transmit, Data Transfer Trigger and Control registers, APU state machine back to idle state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       | FW take-care area:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       | Feature, Feature Exp, Sector Count, Sector Count Exp, LBA Low, LBA Low Exp, LBA Mid, LBA Mid Exp, LBA High, LBA High Exp, Device.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |         |            |
+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 0     | **Data Transfer Trigger**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | 0b      | RW         |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       | **(H_DATA_TRG):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       | This field controls a data transfer and indicates data transfer status in burst mode. Firmware writes one to this field to trigger a data transfer then polls this field to determinate a data transfer is complete or not. This field is cleared by Hardware automatically while a data transfer is completed. This field keeps 1b state when Data FIS ends with R_ERR, DMAT, SYNC Escape, or Data Size Overrun for providing FW sufficient time to run error handling. When merge zone mode is enabled, the field is invalid. |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       | The burst mode indicates data read/write is handled via **Data Transfer Trigger** which is used in PS3103. The merge zone mode indicates data read/write is handled via **Merge Zone Control** which is most same with DDR merge zone in PS3103.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

##### 3.1.27 H_BUF_TRG_SEC (Offset 028h)

Register Index: 028h \~ 02Ah

Default Value: 00000h

Attribute: RW

  ------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------- ------------
   Bit                                                                                                                                                                                                                         Descriptions                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Default   Attributes

   16:0   This field controls sector count of current data transfer for burst mode DMA and merge zone mode DMA. Hardware will auto latch the sector count while receiving a non-NCQ command or activating a NCQ DMA transfer. Firmware is able to re-program this field before triggering data transfer. Maximum transfer size is 65536 sectors, i.e. 0000h in Sector Count of 48-bit LBA. For total transferred sector count is allocated in **H_CMD_TSF_SEC**.   00000h        RW
  ------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------- ------------

##### 3.1.28 H_CMD_REMAIN_SEC (Offset 02Ch)

Register Index: 02Ch \~ 02Fh

Default Value: 0000_0000h

Attribute: RO

  ------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------- ------------
   Bit                                                                                                                                  Descriptions                                                                                                                                  Default   Attributes

   16:0   This field indicates remain sector count of command. When **H_RD_TRG_DONE_SEL** is set to high or command type is write, this field substrate 1 when AXI side complete one sector transfer. Otherwise this field substrate 1 when SATA side complete one sector transfer.   00000h        RW
  ------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------- ------------

|     | This field controls the "I" bit in the RegD2H FIS that trigger by Firmware. Firmware is only able to set this field one then poll this field to determinate whether the FW trigger RegD2H FIS is sent by hardware or not. |         |            |

|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |

|       | 10b: falling edge event                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | 11b: Prohibited                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
+-------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 3     | **SACTIVE Selection when HW send SDB automatically**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | 1b      | RW         |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | **(H_AUTO_SDB_SEL):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | This filed is used to select SACTIVE field in SDB FIS when HW send SDB FIS automatically. When this bit is enabled, HW will send the SACTIVE value decided by last completed NCQ Tag. When this bit is disabled, HW will send the SACTIVE value decide by current NCQ Tag FW set. This may cause the SACTIVE valued mismatch when FW trigger another NCQ command and HW is trying to send SDB FIS.                                                                                                                    |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | 0: Current NCQ Tag                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | 1: Last Completed NCQ Tag                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
+-------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 2     | **Phy event counter 00A Control**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | 0b      | RW         |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | **(H_PHY_EVT_CNT_00A_CTRL):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | This field is used to clear h2d_comri_for_phy00a when receive software reset or other command from host. It means phy event counter 00Ah(CFG_0DBH) will not increase once host sends software reset or command.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | For example:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | COMRESET(Host)-\>Software reset(Host) -\>D2H(Device)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | Phy event counter 00Ah won't increase.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | COMRESET(Host)-\>D2H(Device)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | Phy event counter 00Ah will increase.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | If this bit is disable, phy event counter will increase when FW send the first D2H after COMRESET even there is software reset or other command between them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | 0:Disable                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|       | 1:Enable                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |         |            |
+-------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

##### 3.1.45 H_PM_CTRL (Offset 04Ch)

Register Index: 04Ch \~ 04Dh

Default Value: 3A80h

Attribute: RW/RO

+:---:+:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:+:-------:+:----------:+
| Bit | Descriptions                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default | Attributes |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 15  | **Auto Partial to Slumber request Signal**                                                                                                                                                     | 0b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_REG_APSREQ):**                                                                                                                                                                            |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | This signal requests the direct transition to Slumber from Partial state. If Link layer is in active state and REG_ASPREQ is asserted then Link layer ignores this assertion.                  |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | HW will clear field at following cases:                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 1.  Receive COMRESET/COMWAKE from host                                                                                                                                                         |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 2.  FW assert **H_REG_PMCANCEL**                                                                                                                                                               |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 3.  PHY enters slumber state.                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 14  | **Enable HW auto send DIPM Request**                                                                                                                                                           | 0b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_HW_AUTO_DIPM_EN):**                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | This field is used to enable HW auto send PMREQ to host. When this bit is enable, HW will start a ms timer. Once this timer equal to **H_DIPM_AUTO_TMR_THR**, HW will send PMREQ to Host.      |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 0b: disable                                                                                                                                                                                    |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 1b: enable                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | Note:                                                                                                                                                                                          |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 1.  This field will be cleared when FW asserts **H_APU_RST** and **H_HW_AUTO_DIPM_CLR_SEL** is high.                                                                                           |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 2.  When **H_BLK_TRG** is asserted, HW will clear DIPM required timers.                                                                                                                        |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 13  | **Power State Selection for HW Auto Send DIPM**                                                                                                                                                | 1b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_HW_AUTO_DIPM_PS):**                                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | This field is used to select which power management request HW send to host when **H_HW_AUTO_DIPM_EN** is enable and the timer for HW auto dipm reaches to **H_DIPM_AUTO_TMR_THR**.            |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 0:Slumber                                                                                                                                                                                      |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 1:Partial                                                                                                                                                                                      |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 12  | **COMRI/COMWAKE Directing Wake Up IPM Enable**                                                                                                                                                 | 1b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_CR_OOB_WAKE_EN):**                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | This field is used to enable COMRI/COMWAKE to wake up IPM directly while OOB_MINT missing.                                                                                                     |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 0b:Disable                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 1b:Enable                                                                                                                                                                                      |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 11  | **Enable IPMACK During OOB unestablished(unplug)**                                                                                                                                             | 1b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_CR_OOBN_IPMACK):**                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | This field is used to send IPMACK during OOB unestablished.                                                                                                                                    |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | Device doesn't connect to Host.                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 0b: disable                                                                                                                                                                                    |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 1b: enable                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 10  | **Force IPM_NAK**                                                                                                                                                                              | 0b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_FORCE_IPM_NAK):**                                                                                                                                                                         |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | This field is to force IPM_NAK while FW requires to stop IPM.                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 0: normal                                                                                                                                                                                      |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 1: IPM_NAK                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 9   | **Deny DIPM Request and Gated CLK When D2H not sent for COMRI**                                                                                                                                | 1b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_COMRI_ACT_DENY_IPM):**                                                                                                                                                                    |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | When this bit set one, HW will assert **H_COMRI_ACT** to block DIPM request and gated clock function when receive COMREST from host, and release **H_COMRI_ACT** until D2H sent.               |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 0: Disable                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | 1: Enable                                                                                                                                                                                      |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 8   | **Device Auto Ack Host Initiated Partial/Slumber Request**                                                                                                                                     | 0b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_AUTO_ACK_HIPM):**                                                                                                                                                                         |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | When this bit set one, device will acknowledge host initiated Partial/Slumber request by sending PMACK primitive automatically. This bit is only useful when **H_IPM_EN** is 1'b1.             |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 7   | **Device Interface Power Management Support**                                                                                                                                                  | 1b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_IPM_EN):**                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | This field indicates the SATA device support interface power management or not. This bit is clear, hardware will return PMNAK always while received a host initiated power management request. |         |            |
+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 6   | **Wakeup from Power Management State**                                                                                                                                                         | 0b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_REG_PMCANCEL):**                                                                                                                                                                          |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |

+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 5   | **Device Launch Slumber Request**                                                                                                                                                              | 0b      | RW         |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_REG_PMREQ_S):**                                                                                                                                                                           |         |            |
|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | Firmware set one to launch Slumber state request. Hardware will clear this bit once link enters Slumber state or NAK by host or deny by bus busy.                                              |         |            |

|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |

+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_REG_PMNAK_S):**                                                                                                                                                                           |         |            |

+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_REG_PMNAK_P):**                                                                                                                                                                           |         |            |

+-----+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

|     |                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|     | **(H_REG_PMACK_P):**                                                                                                                                                                           |         |            |

##### 3.1.46 H_DIPM_TIMER_THR (Offset 04Eh)

Register Index: 04E\~04Fh

Default Value: 001Eh

Attribute: RW

+:----:+:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:+:-------:+:----------:+
| Bit  | Descriptions                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default | Attributes |
+------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 15:8 | **DIPM auto wake from Partial and enter Slumber timer Threshold**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | 00h     | RW         |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | **(H_DIPM_AUTO_P2S_THR):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | This field is used to set the timer threshold when Device is in Partial state. If this field is not zero and Device is in Partial state, HW will use a ms timer. When this timer count to this threshold, HW will assert **H_REG_PMCANCEL** to send COMWAKE to wake Host. When LNK_ESTABLISH, HW will assert **H_REG_PMREQ_S** to send PMREQ_S to enter slumber state. |         |            |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | Note:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | a.  8'h1 is prohibited                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | b.  When Host sends SET_FEATURE command to enable DEVSLP function and FW wants to support DevSleep_to_ReducedPwrState feature. Clear this field to avoid Host enter DEVSLP but device try to send COMWAKE to wake host from Partial state.                                                                                                                             |         |            |
+------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

|      | 0:1us                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | 1:1ms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
+------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 6:0  | **DIPM Auto Timer Threshold**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | 1Eh     | RW         |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | **(H_DIPM_AUTO_TMR_THR):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | This field is used to set the timer threshold when HW sends PM request to host. When **H_HW_AUTO_DIPM_EN** is enable and sata bus keeps in idle equal this timer, HW will auto send the PM request. FW needs to set this field first before set enable the **H_HW_AUTO_DIPM_EN**.                                                                                      |         |            |
|      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|      | Note: 7'h1 is prohibited                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |         |            |

+-----+---------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------+------------+
| 31:0                      | This field controls the maximum LBA address for CHS mode that current drive supports. If a received command is CHS mode, HW will transfer command's CHS to LBA then compared with this filed. If the LBA address of a received command equals to or greater than this field, then **H_LBA_ERR** bit in the **H_CMD_INFO** Register will be set. |                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
