|                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|                            | This field controls whether data on AXI write path is flushed before HW sends REG/SDB FIS automatically so as to prevent data coherence issue.                                                                                                                                                                                      |         |            |
|                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|                            | 0b: disabled                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|                            | 1b: enabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
+----------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 4                          | **3 Level Queue Depth Enable**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | 1b      | RW         |
|                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|                            | **(3LEV_Q_DEP_EN):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|                            | This field controls whether queue depth for AXI bus is 3 level or 2 level. When the bit is set to 1'b1, 3 level queue depth is selected, it results in maximum 3 outstanding requests on AXI bus, regardless of read or write direction. But when AXI packet size is 128bytes only read direction is able to send 3 burst commands. |         |            |
|                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|                            | When AXI packet size is 128bytes, use AES fifo as the third packet fifo when AES on the fly is enabled, and use SATA flow control fifo as the third packet fifo when AES on the fly is disabled.                                                                                                                                    |         |            |
|                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|                            | 0b: 2 level                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |         |            |
|                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|                            | 1b: 3 level                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |         |            |
+----------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

The field is same with **Read/Write Command Received**(located at Reg01Eh\[2\]). If FW has to re-program data transfer direction, FW should program **Read/Write Command Received**. |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           | 0b: DDR to SATA                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           | 1b: SATA to DDR                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 0                                                                                                                                                         | **Merge Zone Enable**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | 0b      | RW         |
|                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           | **(H_MZ_EN):**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           | This field is used to enable merge zone. When the field is set to 1'b1, merge zone mode is enabled, and merge zone DMA can be activated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           | 0b: disable                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           | 1b: enable                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                                                                                                                                                           | The burst mode indicates data read/write is handled via **Data Transfer Trigger** which is used for SATA in PS3103. The merge zone mode indicates data read/write is handled via **Merge Zone Control** which is most same with DDR merge zone in PS3103.                                                                                                                                                                   |         |            |

##### 3.1.86 H_AES_CHK_LBA_LEN (Offset 0F4h)

Register Index: 0F4h

Default Value: 0h

Attribute: RO

+:---:+:-------------------:+:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:+:-------:+:----------:+
| Bit | Descriptions                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default | Attributes |

| 31:0                      | **H_AES_CHK_LBA_LEN:**                                                                                                                                                         | 0h      | RO         |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to indicate the length that FW can use the same AES group for data encrypt or decrypt.                                                                      |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|                           | It has three condition and has priority as below:                                                                                                                              |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|                           | 1.  **H_AES_CHK_LBA_SUM==5'h1**, this field will show the value "**H_AES_CHK_LBA_E - H_AES_CHK_LBA_S + 1**"                                                                    |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|                           | 2.  **H_AES_CHK_LBA_GRP!=5'h0**, this field will show the value "**H_AES_GN_E - H_AES_CHK_LBA_S + 1**", **N** equals the value of **H_AES_CHK_LBA_GRP**                        |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|                           | 3.  Otherwise, this field will show the value "**H_AES_GN_S - H_AES_CHK_LBA_S**", **N** is the second AES group number that **H_AES_CHK_LBA_S\~ H_AES_CHK_LBA_E** region hits. |         |            |

##### 3.2.1 H_NCQ_RD_SER (Offset 0C0h)

Register Index: 0C0h

Default Value: 00h

Attribute: RW/RO

| 7:1                       | **Reserved.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | 00h     | RO         |
+---------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 0                         | **NCQ Read Command Search Trigger**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | 0b      | RW         |

|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to trigger HW start to search all read NCQ command in the queue. Only support merge zone size 4K,8K,16K and channel number 4,8. HW will search every valid read NCQ command, if it's sector count \<= merge zone size, then set it's tag into corresponding channel number. If this channel number is already set by one NCQ read command, it won't be replaced by another NCQ read command tag satisfy the condition. When HW search all NCQ command this bit will be set to 1'b0. |         |            |

##### 3.2.18 H_TQ_CONTENT (Offset 380h)

+--------------------+-------------------------+--------------------+----------------+
| H_TQ_CONTENT                                                                       |
+--------------------+-------------------------+--------------------+----------------+
| TQ 0 EC \[31:24\]  | TQ 0 TAG+UPD \[23:18\]  | TQ 0 PTR \[17:0\]  | 380h           |
+--------------------+-------------------------+--------------------+----------------+
| ....                                                                               |
+--------------------+-------------------------+--------------------+----------------+
| TQ n EC \[31:24\]  | TQ n TAG+UPD \[23:18\]  | TQ n PTR \[17:0\]  | 380h+4n        |
+--------------------+-------------------------+--------------------+----------------+
| ....                                                                               |
+--------------------+-------------------------+--------------------+----------------+
| TQ 31 EC \[31:24\] | TQ 31 TAG+UPD \[23:18\] | TQ 31 PTR \[17:0\] | 3FCh           |
+--------------------+-------------------------+--------------------+----------------+

Register Index: 380h \~ 3FFh

Description: This field should be access by DW unit.

Default Value: 0000_0000h

Attribute: RW

+:---:+:-------------------:+:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:+:-------:+:----------:+
| Bit | Descriptions                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default | Attributes |
+-----+---------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 31:24                     | **H_TQN_EC:**                                                                                                                                                                                                    | 0h      | RW         |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to indicate TQ SATA DMA 4K count. HW will use this field to calculate the trigger sector count and write into **BUF_TRG_SEC**.                                                                |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | Write 8'h00 means the command size is larger than 8'hFE and triggered in only once.                                                                                                                              |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | If FW write non-8'h00 value into this field, HW will translate to sector count.                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | First Trigger of this command:                                                                                                                                                                                   |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 8\***H_TQN_EC** - COMMAND_LBA\[2:0\]                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | Multi-trigger of this command:                                                                                                                                                                                   |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 8\***H_TQN_EC**                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | Note,                                                                                                                                                                                                            |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 1.  HW will clear this field to 8'hFF when this DMA starts. FW can write the next-trigger into this DW.                                                                                                          |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 2.  When Multi-trigger, please set **H_MULTI_TRG** to 1'b1                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 23                        | **H_TQN_UPD_PTR:**                                                                                                                                                                                               | 0h      | RW         |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to update memory access address or not.                                                                                                                                                       |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | When FW fill the TQ and with this bit set to high, HW will access the new memory address calculated by **H_TQN_PTR**. If this bit is set to low, HW will use the last command completed accessed memory address. |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | HW will clear this field to 1'b0 when this DMA starts.                                                                                                                                                           |         |            |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 22:18                     | **H_TQN_TAG:**                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 0h      | RW         |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to indicate NCQ tag. For PIO or DMA command FW should fill this field with 5'h0.                                                                                                              |         |            |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 17                        | **H_TQN_BASE:**                                                                                                                                                                                                  | 0b      | RW         |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to indicate which memory base address is selected for this trigger.                                                                                                                           |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 0: **H_BUF_BASE1**                                                                                                                                                                                               |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 1: **H_BUF_BASE2**                                                                                                                                                                                               |         |            |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 16                        | **H_MULTI_TRG:**                                                                                                                                                                                                 | 0b      | RW         |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to indicate this CMD is single triggered or is separated to small fragments and multi-triggered.                                                                                              |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 0: single trigger                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 1: multi-trigger                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 15                        | **H_SEND_ZERO_DATA:**                                                                                                                                                                                            | 0b      | RW         |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to indicate the data of this CMD sent to host is all zero data or normal data.                                                                                                                |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | When the data is all zero, H_TQN_PTR shall be set to reasonable buffer address. APU will not sign any flag but needs to read data from AXI.                                                                      |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 0: normal data                                                                                                                                                                                                   |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 1: zero data                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 14:0                      | **H_TQN_PTR:**                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 0h      | RW         |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | This field is used to indicate TQ SATA DMA 4K pointer. HW will use this field to calculate the memory access address from 4K based into sector based and write into **BUF_OFST**. The translation flow is below: |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | First Trigger of this command:                                                                                                                                                                                   |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 8\***H_TQN_PTR +** COMMAND_LBA\[2:0\]                                                                                                                                                                            |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | Multi-trigger of this command:                                                                                                                                                                                   |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | 8\***H_TQN_PTR**                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |         |            |
|                           | Maximum address map size is 128MB                                                                                                                                                                                |         |            |
+---------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

[]{#__RefHeading___Toc401839600 .anchor}3.3 Debug Register

##### 3.3.1 H_DUPE_CMD_BLK_5-1 (Offset 200h)

Description:

"Duplicated Command Block 1-(1\~4)" is to duplicate previous command structure. "Duplicated Command Block 2-(1\~4)" is to duplicate "Duplicated Command Block 1-(1\~4)". "Duplicated Command Block 3-(1\~4)" is to duplicate "Buffered Command Block 2-(1\~4)". "Duplicated Command Block 4-(1\~4)" is to duplicate "Buffered Command Block 3-(1\~4)". "Duplicated Command Block 5-(1\~4)" is to duplicate "Buffered Command Block 4-(1\~4)". The copy behavior is done every time on receiving a H2D Reg FIS. Thus, FW can get previous 5 command block registers via "Duplicated Command Block 1\~4".

Register Index: 200h\~203h

Default Value: 00000000h

Attribute: RW/RO

+:-----:+:-------------------------------------------------------:+:-------:+:----------:+
| Bit   | Descriptions                                            | Default | Attributes |
+-------+---------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 31:24 | Sector Exp                                              | 00h     | RW         |
|       |                                                         |         |            |
|       | COMRESET or SoftRST show 8'h00                          |         |            |
+-------+---------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 23:16 | Sector                                                  | 00h     | RW         |
|       |                                                         |         |            |
|       | COMRESET or SoftRST show 8'h01                          |         |            |
+-------+---------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 15:8  | Feature Exp                                             | 00h     | RW         |
|       |                                                         |         |            |
|       | COMRESET or SoftRST show last command Feature Exp value |         |            |
+-------+---------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+
| 7:0   | Feature                                                 | 00h     | RW         |
|       |                                                         |         |            |
|       | COMRESET or SoftRST show last command Feature value     |         |            |
+-------+---------------------------------------------------------+---------+------------+

|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|       | This field is used for SCT Error Recovery Control sets time limits for write timer2 timeout. For non-NCQ command, timer starts counting when receiving command. For NCQ command, timer clears when receive NCQ write command and starts when NCQ write command exist. When timer reaches this value, **H_SCT_W2_TMO_CNT** increase and decrease when timer reaches **H_SCT_W_TMR.** |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|       | Unit:10ms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|       | 16'h0: No write timer2 timeout                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|       | 16'h1: 10ms timeout                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |         |            |
|       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |         |            |
|       | SCT write related timer should have this relationship: **H_SCT_W_TMR\*100ms \> H_SCT_W2_TMR\*10ms \> H_SCT_W1_TMR\*10ms**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |         |            |

##### 3.3.43 H_NCQ_ORDER_INFO (Offset 290h)

+:-----------------------:+:-----------------------:+:----:+
| NCQ Order 1             | NCQ Order 0             | 290h |
+-------------------------+-------------------------+------+
| .....                                             |      |
+-------------------------+-------------------------+------+
| NCQ Order 31            | NCQ Order 30            | 2CCh |
+-------------------------+-------------------------+------+

Register Index: 290h \~ 2CFh

Description: Each NCQ Command Order occupies 2bytes register space which contains 5-bits Tag. When FW wants to execute NCQ by this "NCQ Command Order Info Table". FW can execute NCQ Order 0 (always execute this one) until **H_REMAIN_VLD_NCQ_NUM** becomes to zero. NCQ Order 0 queue the oldest NCQ command Tag, NCQ Order 31 queue the latest NCQ command Tag.

For NCQ write command, HW will also confirm this NCQ command only occupied one merge zone. If FW set **H_NCQ_R_CHK_SZ_SEL** 1'b1, HW will check NCQ read size info as NCQ write. |         |            |

|                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |            |

## 4 SATA APU Command Decode Table

In order to improve performance and maintain function code of PIO/DMA/FPDMA, Hardware helps to decode some command codes and reports to Firmware. Please notices that Firmware still has the highest priority to change these setting before any data transfer.
